I will keep this small sorghum piece the way I know works for me. The plot is very small, and cash is tight, so I will not buy fertilizer or chemicals for it; I will put manure if I have it from home and use my local seed, the kind I have seen do well here. I do not irrigate this plot, and with intercropping I will manage it mostly with my own family labor.
